hero.eyebrow: Pots and supplies for garden centres and florists
hero.title: Wholesale indoor and outdoor pots
hero.lead: We import and distribute ceramic, terracotta and fiberstone pots for garden centres, nurseries, florists and landscape architects. Over two thousand items, one trusted partner.

azienda.title: Specialists in professional pot supply
azienda.p1: LUIS S.r.l. is an Italian company specialising in the import and distribution of pots for gardens, terraces and interior design. We offer our customers a wide range of indoor and outdoor pots with refined lines and premium materials: from authentic terracotta to elegant glazed ceramic and modern fiberstone.
azienda.p2: We work with garden centres, nurseries and landscape architects, offering tailored solutions for every green project with direct, ongoing sales support.
azienda.fact1: Trusted partner of nurseries, florists and architects since 1995
azienda.fact2: Luis collection and selected international brands
azienda.fact3: Own warehouse in Bergamo, shipping throughout Italy

valori.title: The trusted partner to shape your green projects
valori.assortimentoText: Over 2,000 items including pots, terracotta, baskets and garden supplies, ready to ship.
valori.qualitaText: We select only high-quality products from certified suppliers, checked one by one.
valori.consegnaText: Efficient logistics and a well-stocked warehouse for quick delivery times.
valori.supportoText: An expert team by your side, from pre-sale advice to after-sales assistance.

collezioni.title: Discover our collections
collezioni.lead: The Luis collection has two souls: the exclusive line, synonymous with quality and versatility, and the international brands we resell, icons of contemporary design.

marchi.title: International excellence
marchi.potteryText: Lightweight, durable pots with Dutch design, ideal for contract spaces too.
marchi.capiText: Sustainable design and contemporary colours, made from recycled materials.
